lines.text: Tears on my pillow, nights feeling blue,
You keep playing games, what am I to do?
Promises shattered like glass on the floor,
Can't take this pain anymore.
Time to stand up, wipe away the rain,
No more chains, break the strain.
Stop the hurt, let me go,
Heart's been broken, now you know.
No more lies, no more fights,
Stop the hurt, turn out the lights.
Memories fade, but scars remain,
Learning to dance in the pouring rain.
Won't let you pull me down low,
Rising up, stealing the show.
Strength inside, ready to fly,
Say goodbye, no more cry.
Stop the hurt, let me go,
Heart's been broken, now you know.
No more lies, no more fights,
Stop the hurt, turn out the lights.
One last look, then I'm gone,
New dawn, moving on.
Stop the hurt, let me go,
Heart's been broken, now you know.
No more lies, no more fights,
Stop the hurt, embrace the nights.
